headline: Total Transport Systems Reports Robust Q2 FY27 Performance
hook: Strong revenue and profit growth reported
summary: Total Transport Systems Limited announced its Q2 FY27 financial results on November 5, 2026. The company posted a 73.7% year-on-year increase in revenue to ₹284 crore. EBITDA grew 2.2 times to ₹10 crore, while PAT rose 3 times to ₹7 crore compared to the same quarter last year. Indian retail investors tracking small-cap logistics companies can note this earnings growth.
whats_next: Next quarterly results in Q3 FY27
why_it_matters: Higher earnings improve fundamentals for small-cap logistics holders.
winners_losers: Total Transport shareholders gain / competitors hurt
